entries.title: Book VI: The Senses
entries.content:
"Αἱ αἰσθήσεις μάρτυρες τῆς ἀληθείας εἰσίν."
(The senses are witnesses of the truth.)

entries.title: Book VI: The Senses
entries.content: Perception enters the body. Sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch are traced through sense organs and nerves, linking the external world to the brain.

entries.title: Book VI: The Senses
entries.content: Perception follows a path—from sense organs, through nerves, to the brain.

entries.title: Book VI: The Senses
entries.content: What was once unseen becomes something that can be followed, examined, and questioned.
